title: The push argv check accepted the atomic flag and explicit lease followed by --no-atomic --no-force-with-lease
resolution: The whole push argv is compared with taskBranchPushArguments; cancelsAtomic and cancelsLease variants fail.

title: The argv secret check searched only the raw secret and missed the encoded Authorization header
resolution: sensitiveValues covers the secret, the authorization value, its credential part, and the base64 of each; passesHeaderInArguments fails.

title: A finding's diagnostic label repeated every argument, so it echoed the secret it found
resolution: Labels name the pid and operation and argv is redacted before formatting; tests prove no finding contains a credential.

title: Environment key names alone let an inherited GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL or GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n pass, and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 was unchecked
resolution: Redacted environment values are observed and checked; inheritsGlobalConfig and inheritsConfigPairs fail.

title: plantGitSetting wrote invalid Git config under an existing [core] section
resolution: Settings are planted with git config --file --add, and a test lists them with the real Git parser.

title: A final config without planted settings did not prove they never acted, so an adapter that used and then removed them passed
resolution: Each observed process carries the .git/config it found at start; rewritesConfigAfterGit fails.

title: Non-UTF-8 paths and symlink targets were deferred to 16b though the string-typed snapshot API cannot carry them
resolution: Refused with non-utf8-path through decodeGitPath and isUtf8Text in the contract, spec, types, and tests.

title: The macOS reclaim requirement contradicted Git process identity, which required the reclaim program in its own containment
resolution: A full MODIFIED Git process identity distinguishes Linux and macOS.

title: The contract said every operation but list and sweep returns Result, missing handedOff
resolution: handedOff is listed with list and sweep, with its disk error behaviour.

title: The double's PAX parser split records on newline, cutting a long filename that contains one
resolution: Records are parsed by their byte length, with a regression test.

title: The double's archive reader lost a file named __proto__ by assigning into a plain object
resolution: Uses Object.create(null), with a regression test.

title: readRemoteHead during the hand-off could run in the checkout and read the agent's .git/config, sending the Authorization header through insteadOf or a proxy
resolution: Git processes that need no checkout start in GIT_NEUTRAL_DIRECTORY (/); the fixture reports cwd and the found repository config; a hand-off case and readsRemoteInCheckout added.

title: The environment rule covered only GIT_* and SUDO_UID, leaving HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, proxies, CA bundles and SSH_ASKPASS
resolution: A full environment allowlist in section 7, checked by environmentProblems; inheritsUserEnvironment fails.

title: Uniform redaction let the suite accept a header other than the operation's exact Authorization value
resolution: redactedHeader marks only the exact header of the operation's credential and unredacted values are scanned; sendsSecretAsHeader fails.

title: WorkspaceCredential.authorization had no producer and the GitHub header scenario bound the plugin from git-workspace-port
resolution: A section 14 obligation on item 20 and its g3-plan row; the scenario now tests that the supplied value is used verbatim.

title: The insecure-remote cases checked neither remote calls nor the order against the credential check
resolution: remoteCalls is checked around each refusal and an insecure remote with a foreign credential expects insecure-remote; callsRemoteBeforeTransport fails.

title: The ignoresLease variant never pushed over a moved remote, so the remote-keeps-head check was unproven
resolution: The variant checks ancestry against the expected head and pushes; the case catches it.

title: encodeHeadSnapshot took a plain record, so a __proto__ path could be lost silently
resolution: Takes a ReadonlyMap; a conformance check covers a __proto__ file.

title: The MODIFIED push requirement dropped that it updates only the task branch
resolution: Restored.

title: Reclaim program containment required a containment without the same-identity exception
resolution: The exception is stated.

title: The encoder checked non-utf8-path before gitlink-in-tree, opposite to section 9
resolution: Gitlinks are checked first.

title: Writing reclaim-failed had no crash point, so a crash could re-run the program against never re-run
resolution: Section 3 step 7 accepts the window explicitly because the program is idempotent.

title: The planted-settings case took since after the reclaim, leaving the reclaim's processes unchecked
resolution: since is taken before the reclaim.

title: Archive tests did not fix UTF-8 byte order, the 100-byte pax boundary, or compare the suite's bytes with the encoder
resolution: Tests for astral versus U+E000 order and the boundary; the suite compares bytes with the encoder of the decoded tree.

title: The non-UTF-8 path scenario had no fixture hook or conformance case
resolution: Recorded as a 16b follow-up.

title: The spec did not say the package revision is checked at image build, and argv[0] was not checked against the pinned path
resolution: Stated in the spec; the suite checks argv[0]; runsGitFromPath fails.

title: The worker start slot rule sits in git-workspace-port
resolution: Recorded as a 16e follow-up for worker-runtime.

title: On macOS an agent with the same uid can read the Git process environment and its header, unrecorded
resolution: Recorded in section 7 as an accepted residual risk.

title: taskBranchPushOptions was public though only the double used it
resolution: No longer exported.

title: verification.md said no review had run, had stale requirement lengths, an old case name and overlay for overlay2, and task 4.2 was unticked
resolution: Corrected and task 4.2 ticked.
